title: Onboard harmony-11b-v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description: Onboard harmony-11b v1.0 into the model registry with canonical metadata, generated performance profiles for our standard throughput/latency targets, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: provide a validated open 11B model variant optimized for Redwood inference with verified perf characteristics and to avoid manual churn when onboarding future minor model revisions. This PR includes: 1) models/harmony-11b/v1.0/metadata.yaml with license, tokenizer, recommended quantization, and model card pointers; 2) generated perf profiles (40/2048 token buckets) produced by perf-lab harness and formatted per registry schema; 3) small inference example and instructions for engineers and docs; 4) a changelog automation hook that appends a templated release note when new model metadata is merged; 5) lightweight validation script to run synthetic perf sanity checks in CI. Checklist: [x] metadata file added, [x] perf profiles generated, [x] CI perf sanity checks, [x] changelog automation configured, [x] docs example + quickstart. Tests: unit + lint + perf sanity in CI passed; manual spot-checks on n1-standard equivalent machines. Linear/Context: ENG-3245 tracks onboarding effort and validation, PM-878 requested model for customer trial. Rollback plan: revert PR and remove model entry from registry, revoke any pre-release tags if necessary. No user-facing API changes.
